name: office-sarcasm
prompt: Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 comedy video: an employee pretends to work, then makes absurd reaction faces every time the boss appears. Expressions are the main source of comedy; include close-up reaction shots.

message.hook: Gary is laughing at cat videos at 9:01 AM. The boss is right behind him.
key_points: Rule of three: the boss appears three times, each reaction face is bigger
Pretend-work: monitor snaps to a spreadsheet, fake typing, fake professionalism
Twist: the boss only wanted the cat video
message.cta: Meme caption punchline: THE BOSS WAS PRETENDING TOO

style_brief: Sarcastic Grotesque (BM.STYLE grotesque). Face-first reaction-meme comedy: dirty sage office, thick ink outlines, Anton meme subtitles. Motion signature: calm medium beat -> snap reaction (GR.react, 0.12 s anticipation, camera punch to close/ECU, smear, eye pop) -> speed/burst/dread backdrop -> comedic freeze hold -> hard cut. >=50% close-ups/ECUs, cuts every 1-2.5 s. Music low (awkward), sfx carry the jokes.

cast.role: smug boss who keeps appearing behind him
cast.placement: back-left plane (250, 700, s .95), slides in/out from the left

sets: GR.BG.office (sage wall, flickering light, SYNERGY poster, sticky notes)
reaction backdrops: speed, dread, burst, rage
props: GR.monitor with screens: cat meme (CAT FAILS #47) / spreadsheet (Q3_FINAL_final(2).xlsx)
GR.label time stamps 9:01 AM / 11:40 AM / 4:59 PM

script.text: Relax. Send me the cat video.

storyboard.visual: 9:01 AM label. Gary cackles at CAT FAILS #47; Brock slides in behind him, unseen
Gary still laughing -> SNAP shockScream, eyes pop, speed lines; freeze hold
monitor snaps to spreadsheet, frantic fake typing, Brock: Busy, Gary?
fakePro, adjusting tie, trembling: Crunching numbers, sir.
Brock suspicious hold, slides out; Gary deflates
11:40 AM label. Gary asleep and drooling, zz; Brock slides back in
terrified ECU on dread backdrop -> snap to giant fakeSmile on burst backdrop; freeze hold
Brock side-eye ECU, then slides out; Gary done
4:59 PM label. Gary evil grin, rubbing hands, cat video back on; Brock already behind him
panic -> terrified -> hysterical cry, each a snap with rage/burst/speed backdrops
Brock smug then greedy: Relax. Send me the cat video. Cut to Gary frozen mid-sob
storyboard.text: RELAX. SEND ME THE CAT VIDEO.

storyboard.visual: Gary whatDidISee ECU, held 1.7 s, meme caption THE BOSS WAS PRETENDING TOO

gags.name: caught laughing
gags.timing: 0.8 s silent boss close -> snap shockScream + eye pop -> 0.6 s freeze hold

gags.name: caught napping
gags.timing: double snap terrified -> fakeSmile, 0.7 s hold on the grin

gags.name: caught a third time
gags.timing: escalation panic/terrified/hystericalCry every 0.5 s (rule of three, biggest last)

gags.name: twist punchline
gags.timing: boss asks for the cat video -> whatDidISee ECU held to the end with rimshot

publish._note: Publishing is intentionally not wired. Human review first.
